tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all Dataplex healthcare data products: CMS provider, facility, nursing home and prior authorization compliance data, FDA adverse events (FAERS/MAUDE), CDC public health statistics, NPPES NPI provider records, hospital and Medicaid spending. Returns slug, name, one-liner, price, and links for each.

tools.name: search_health_datasets
tools.description: Search Dataplex healthcare datasets by keyword (e.g. 'Medicare physician spending', 'nursing home compliance', 'prior authorization CMS-0057', 'FDA adverse events', 'NPI provider', 'CDC drug overdose deaths'). Matches product names and descriptions, 300+ CMS feed titles, 1,500+ CDC dataset names, and column names; returns matching products with the specific feeds, datasets and columns that matched.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'Medicare physician spending' or 'FDA adverse events'. Matches product names, feed titles, dataset names, and column names.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Full metadata for one Dataplex product: description, key facts, tables, temporal coverage, update frequency, feed or dataset catalog preview (CMS, CDC), price, docs, Snowflake Marketplace listing.

slug.description: Product identifier (e.g. 'cms_data_feeds', 'npi_registry', 'cdc_public_health'). Call list_products to get valid slugs.

tools.name: get_data_dictionary
tools.description: Column-level data dictionary for one Dataplex product: tables, columns with types and descriptions, temporal coverage, and validated SQL including the non-obvious query patterns (current-release filters, dedupe flags, text-encoded numbers). Pass table to get one table's columns; enough to plan an analysis before subscribing.

slug.description: Product identifier (e.g. 'cms_data_feeds', 'npi_registry', 'cdc_public_health'). Call list_products to get valid slugs.

table.description: Table or view name to get columns for, e.g. 'HOSPITAL_GENERAL_INFORMATION'. Omit to get a table index with column counts.

tools.name: get_sample_data
tools.description: 100 REAL rows from a Dataplex product's primary table — the same governed views sold on Snowflake and Databricks. No signup needed. Use this to evaluate schema and content quality.

slug.description: Product identifier (e.g. 'cms_data_feeds', 'npi_registry', 'cdc_public_health'). Call list_products to get valid slugs.

max_rows.description: Number of sample rows to return (1-100, default 25).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Machine-readable pricing for all Dataplex products: monthly price, free-trial link, Snowflake Marketplace listing URL.

tools.name: get_snowflake_trial_sql
tools.description: Copy-paste SQL for an agent INSIDE a Snowflake account to mount a Dataplex listing and start querying trial data in minutes — no browser, no sales call.

slug.description: Product identifier (e.g. 'cms_data_feeds', 'npi_registry', 'cdc_public_health'). Call list_products to get valid slugs.

tools.name: get_access_options
tools.description: Every way to get full access to a Dataplex product: Snowflake Marketplace, Databricks, free trial, docs, human contact.

slug.description: Product identifier (e.g. 'cms_data_feeds', 'npi_registry', 'cdc_public_health'). Call list_products to get valid slugs.
